operating_notes.text: Shareholders approved Employee Stock Option Plan 2026 and Employee Share Purchase Plan 2026 via Trust route.
Material related party transactions with identified related parties were approved by shareholders via postal ballot.
Management reassessed the useful economic life of plant and machinery to 40 years, reducing H1FY27 depreciation by ₹73 crores.
Sakti Thermal Power Plant Unit #1 synchronized on 25 Oct 2026.

holders.name: LIC Pension Plus Non Unit Fund

timeline.summary: Vedanta Power shareholders approved 9 postal ballot resolutions covering ESOP/ESPP 2026 plans and material related party transactions.
2026-10-29: Vedanta Power approved 78.11 lakh ESOPs under VPL ESOP 2026 at ₹10 per share
H1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹5,515 Cr, net loss ₹340 Cr.
Vedanta Power Q2 revenue rises 38% YoY to ₹2,908 Cr; EBITDA jumps 122% to ₹421 Cr
Rajinder Singh Ahuja, Whole Time Director & CEO, hosted earnings conference call on unaudited Q2 & H1 2026 results via audio recording available at www.vedantapower.com on October 29, 2026.
